prompt.initial: First, press the blue water button beside the sink to turn on the faucet and fill the pot already in the sink. While the pot fills, retrieve the can from the cabinet: open the sliding door, take out the can, and place it in the marked area. After placing the can, you may either return to the sink and press the same blue button to turn off the faucet before closing the cabinet door, or close the cabinet door before returning to turn off the faucet. When the faucet is off, the can is in the marked area, and the cabinet door is closed, press the red completion button beside the sink to finish the task.

When the burner and toaster oven are off and both drawers have been inspected and closed, press either green completion button.
